name: Metabolic Phase Week 1: Block 1 Microcycle 1
description: Carry out the first set at an RIR of 3, the second at an RIR of 2, and the final set at an RIR of 1. Rest 30 seconds between sets.

name: Metabolic Phase Week 2: Block 1 Microcycle 2
description: Carry out the first set at an RIR of 3, the second at an RIR of 2, and the final set at an RIR of 1. Rest 30 seconds between supersets.

name: Metabolic Phase Week 3: Block 1 Microcycle 3
description: Carry out the first set at an RIR of 3, the second at an RIR of 2, and the final set at an RIR of 1. Rest as little as possible between exercises during each circuit; rest approximately one to two minutes between circuits.

name: Metabolic Phase Week 4: Block 1 Microcycle 4
description: Perform each set at an RIR of about 4.
